TCD.note: The article studies municipal digitalisation management and names no national digital strategy.
It surveys Chadian communes on digitalisation management and states nothing on office connection.

facts.fact: A researcher at the Université de Moundou (Chad) published a journal article, based on 15 interviews and 220 surveys of municipal councillors and service heads in Chadian communes, on managing the digitalisation of municipal services.

TCD.note: The article says nothing on startups.
The article says nothing on hubs or parks.
